findings.message:
[P2] Reconcile aggregate terminal items across all positions

When streamed deltas carry item IDs at multiple positions and Surplus later emits one id-less aggregate item, this guard sees the aggregate's `output:0:0` key as present and skips the repeat check. Surplus joins all buffered parts into that item; for `ha` at positions 0 and 1, the aggregate `haha` is reconciled only against the first `ha` and appends another `ha`, yielding `hahaha` in both Chat modes.

src/chat/stream-translation.ts:120-121

[P2] Preserve item-id aliases when positional fields are missing

If a delta has `item_id` and `output_index` but its corresponding done/content event has the same item ID without `output_index`, this function stores them under different keys (`output:0:0` versus `item:<id>:0`). Identified events bypass the repeat fallback, so the completed text or refusal is emitted in full a second time; the storage lookup needs to retain the item-id alias when positional metadata is absent.

src/chat/stream-translation.ts:80-80

summary: The positional deduplication fix covers the reported case, but introduces duplicate output for aggregate terminal items and inconsistent event metadata.

evidence: src/chat/stream-translation.ts:69-80 adds output/content-position storage keys and the changed Chat translation paths use them for text and refusal accumulation.
src/chat/stream-translation.ts:94-110 matches id-less repeats by their output/content position before the guarded compatibility fallback.
